findings.label: Tags column stored as indented JSON
findings.detail: BindItem serializes the Tags column with the shared WriteIndented=true options, producing multi-line JSON. Harmless because the column is never read back (queries use DataJson -> _items), but a compact serialization would be tidier if the column ever becomes a SQL query source.

findings.label: Legacy sidecars left on disk after import
findings.detail: Existing *_metadata.json files are intentionally left in place (least-destructive, documented) and made safe by the empty-table guard. A future cleanup pass is optional, only if stale files on disk become a concern.
